lines.zh: 浅水的沙面被我划出细纹。
lines.en: I trace fine lines across the shallow sand.

lines.zh: 我喷一股水，慢慢往前滑。
lines.en: I squirt a jet of water and glide ahead.

lines.zh: 阳光透过水面，落在壳上。
lines.en: Sunlight through the surface falls on my shell.
I round the coral without breaking it.

lines.zh: 深处太黑，我还是回浅滩。
lines.en: The deep is too dark; I head back to the shallows.

lines.zh: 壳里注水，我一寸寸沉下去。
lines.en: Water fills my shell and I sink inch by inch.
In my spiral shell, I rise slowly.
I draw every tentacle back into my shell.
The gas in my shell swells and shrinks.
I hang motionless in the water column.
The silt settles and I emerge again.

lines.zh: 触手伸出壳外，探你的气息。
lines.en: My tentacles reach out to sense your scent.

lines.zh: 我这只活化石，正慢慢上浮看你。
lines.en: This living fossil rises slowly to look at you.
Half a pocket of air left in my shell.

lines.zh: 螺壳缓缓转向，盯住你的手。
lines.en: My shell slowly turns to watch your hands.

lines.zh: 我这只活化石只会慢慢上浮。
lines.en: A living fossil, I only drift up slowly.
My shell turns to face you straight on.
My shell spirals like an old eye.

lines.zh: 壳里藏着古老秘密，别轻易打开！
lines.en: Keep the secrets of the shell, do not open easily!

lines.zh: 浅水深处，藏着我的食物宝藏。
lines.en: Treasures of food hidden in shallow waters.

lines.zh: 深水偶尔才出现，捕食更艰难。
lines.en: Appears in deep waters rarely, making hunting harder.

lines.zh: 鹦鹉螺壳，珍贵之物，得来不易。
lines.en: The nautilus shell, a precious find, hard to obtain.

lines.zh: 小心！我用壳抵御深海压力。
lines.en: Beware! I use my shell to withstand deep-sea pressure.

lines.zh: 用壳保护自己，深海生存之道。
lines.en: Protect myself with the shell, a deep-sea survival tactic.

lines.zh: 鹦鹉螺壳，是唯一的生存希望。
lines.en: The nautilus shell is my sole survival hope.

lines.zh: 深海中的我，静静等待机会。
lines.en: I wait quietly in the deep sea.

lines.zh: 浅水适合我的生活，也适合你。
lines.en: Shallow waters suit my life, and yours too.

lines.zh: 别碰我的壳，小心被弹开。
lines.en: Do not touch my shell, you might be弹开。

lines.zh: 我体型庞大，碰撞能伤人！
lines.en: My size can hurt you on collision!

lines.zh: 碰撞时，我用壳保护自己。
lines.en: Protect myself with the shell on collision.

lines.zh: 小心碰撞，壳有保护作用。
lines.en: Beware of collisions, the shell protects.

lines.zh: 碰撞时，我的壳不会破裂。
lines.en: On collision, my shell will not break.

lines.zh: 壳是我的生命之壳，坚固无比。
lines.en: The shell is my life shell, unbreakable.

lines.zh: 碰撞中，壳是我的唯一屏障。
lines.en: On collision, the shell is my only barrier.

lines.zh: 小心，壳是我唯一的防身武器。
lines.en: Beware, the shell is my only weapon.
Be careful of my shell on collision.
Finding a mate is hard in the deep sea.

lines.zh: 深海中偶遇伴侣，珍贵机会。
lines.en: A rare chance to meet a mate in the deep sea.

lines.zh: 鹦鹉螺寻找伴侣，深海中的舞蹈。
lines.en: Nautilus dances in the deep sea, seeking a mate.

lines.zh: 深海中，寻找伴侣的旅程。
lines.en: A journey to find a mate in the deep sea.

lines.zh: 鹦鹉螺在深海中寻找伴侣。
lines.en: Nautilus searches for a mate in the deep sea.

lines.zh: 深海中的伴侣，珍贵如宝石。
lines.en: A mate in the deep sea is precious like a gem.

lines.zh: 深海中，寻找伴侣的使命。
lines.en: A mission to find a mate in the deep sea.

lines.zh: 深海中，寻找伴侣的冒险。
lines.en: An adventure to find a mate in the deep sea.

lines.zh: 深海中的鹦鹉螺，寻找伴侣。
lines.en: Nautilus in the deep sea, seeking a mate.
Shell speaks, no need for words.

lines.zh: 浅水是我家，鹦鹉螺之壳。
水一动，我立刻缩回壳里。
lines.en: The water stirs and I retract into my shell.

lines.zh: 有大东西游过，我沉下去。
lines.en: Something large swims by; I sink lower.

lines.zh: 光与影的游戏，我的主场。
光为武器，亦为藏身之所。
我贴着沙底，尽量不出声。
lines.en: I hug the sandy floor and stay silent.

lines.zh: 触手只伸出一根探探路。
lines.en: I extend just one tentacle to test the way.
As it nears, I retreat toward deeper water.

lines.zh: 你竟然攻击我？我要用壳反击！
lines.en: You dare attack me? I'll use my shell to fight back!

lines.zh: 我的壳是天然防身武器！
lines.en: My shell is a natural self-defense weapon!
I'll smash your head with my shell!
Leave me alone, I have a hard shell!
I'll smash you with my hard shell!
My shell is harder than you think!
My shell is harder than stone!
I have no teeth — only my shell to block with!
I can bump you, but I cannot fight you.
I'm going to lay eggs, find the shell!
The egg-laying spot must be safe...

lines.zh: 产卵需要一片静谧之地...

lines.en: I lay my eggs and wait for them to grow...

lines.zh: 我从化石层里被复原出来。
lines.en: I am revived from the fossil layer.
The egg splits open in the shallows.

lines.zh: 一只小小的鹦鹉螺游了出来。
深海偶尔也有我的影子。
lines.en: Now and then my shadow crosses the deep.
Fell into deep water, shell shattered
